You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(showtext)
library(dplyr)

results <- read_csv("northfield_results_tidy.csv")

glimpse(results)
```

```{r}
precincts <- st_read("Precinct.shp")

glimpse(precincts)
```

```{r}
northfield_precincts <- precincts |>
  filter(Township_N == "NORTHFIELD")

glimpse(northfield_precincts)
```

```{r}
results |> 
  filter(race == "US Senate") |> 
  distinct(precinct, precinct_num) |> 
  arrange(precinct_num)
```

```{r}
results |> 
  filter(race == "US Senate") |> 
  distinct(precinct, precinct_num) |> 
  arrange(precinct_num) |> 
  print(n = 59)
```

```{r}
results <- results |> 
  filter(!is.na(precinct_num))
```

```{r}
nrow(results |> distinct(precinct))
```

```{r}
# prepare the join
northfield_precincts <- northfield_precincts |> 
  mutate(precinct_num = as.numeric(Precinct_N))

# filter to just Stratton's results
stratton <- results |> 
  filter(race == "US Senate", candidate == "Juliana Stratton")

# join
map_data <- northfield_precincts |> 
  left_join(stratton, by = "precinct_num")

# map
ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = vote_share)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#1F4E79",
                      labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Juliana Stratton — US Senate",
    subtitle = "Vote share by precinct, Northfield Township (2026 Dem Primary)",
    fill = "Vote Share"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
# filter to both candidates
senate_compare <- results |> 
  filter(race == "US Senate", 
         candidate %in% c("Juliana Stratton", "Raja Krishnamoorthi"))

# join to shapefile
map_data_compare <- northfield_precincts |> 
  left_join(senate_compare, by = "precinct_num")

# map
ggplot(map_data_compare) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = vote_share)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#1F4E79",
                      labels = scales::percent) +
  facet_wrap(~ candidate) +
  labs(
    title = "US Senate — Stratton vs. Krishnamoorthi",
    subtitle = "Vote share by precinct, Northfield Township (2026 Dem Primary)",
    fill = "Vote Share"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
# find winner per precinct
senate_winner <- results |> 
  filter(race == "US Senate") |> 
  group_by(precinct_num) |> 
  slice_max(votes, n = 1) |> 
  ungroup()

# join to shapefile
map_data_winner <- northfield_precincts |> 
  left_join(senate_winner, by = "precinct_num")

# township-wide totals for subtitle
township_totals <- results |> 
  filter(race == "US Senate") |> 
  group_by(candidate) |> 
  summarise(total_votes = sum(votes)) |> 
  arrange(desc(total_votes))

# build subtitle string
subtitle_text <- township_totals |> 
  mutate(label = paste0(candidate, ": ", total_votes)) |> 
  pull(label) |> 
  paste(collapse = "  |  ")

# map
ggplot(map_data_winner) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = vote_share, color = candidate), linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#1F4E79",
                      labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Juliana Stratton"       = "#1F4E79",
    "Raja Krishnamoorthi"    = "#C00000",
    "Robin Kelly"            = "#375623",
    "Kevin Ryan"             = "#FF8C00",
    "Steve Botsford Jr."     = "#7B2D8B",
    "Bryan Maxwell"          = "#008080",
    "Jonathan Dean"          = "#8B4513",
    "Sean Brown"             = "#2F4F4F",
    "Awisi A. Bustos"        = "#B8860B",
    "Christopher Swann"      = "#556B2F"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "US Senate — Winner by Precinct",
    subtitle = subtitle_text,
    fill = "Winner's Vote Share",
    color = "Winner"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7))
```

```{r}
senate_winner |> 
  count(candidate) |> 
  arrange(desc(n))
```

```{r}
# filter to just Stratton and Raja
senate_two <- results |> 
  filter(race == "US Senate", 
         candidate %in% c("Juliana Stratton", "Raja Krishnamoorthi"))

# find winner per precinct and calculate margin
senate_winner_two <- senate_two |> 
  group_by(precinct_num) |> 
  mutate(margin = vote_share - min(vote_share)) |> 
  slice_max(votes, n = 1) |> 
  ungroup()

# join to shapefile
map_data_two <- northfield_precincts |> 
  left_join(senate_winner_two, by = "precinct_num")

# township totals for subtitle
subtitle_text <- results |> 
  filter(race == "US Senate",
         candidate %in% c("Juliana Stratton", "Raja Krishnamoorthi")) |> 
  group_by(candidate) |> 
  summarise(total = sum(votes)) |> 
  arrange(desc(total)) |> 
  mutate(label = paste0(candidate, ": ", total)) |> 
  pull(label) |> 
  paste(collapse = "  |  ")

# map
ggplot(map_data_two) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = interaction(candidate, margin))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colorRampPalette(c("#aec6e8", "#1F4E79"))(30) |> 
      c(colorRampPalette(c("#f4a9a8", "#C00000"))(30)),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  geom_sf(aes(color = candidate), fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Juliana Stratton" = "#1F4E79", 
               "Raja Krishnamoorthi" = "#C00000")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "US Senate — Stratton vs. Krishnamoorthi",
    subtitle = subtitle_text,
    color = "Winner"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
# township totals for subtitle - pct this time
subtitle_text <- results |>
```

```{r}
# create a continuous diverging score: positive = Stratton, negative = Raja
map_data_two <- map_data_two |> 
  mutate(margin_dir = ifelse(candidate == "Juliana Stratton", margin, -margin))

ggplot(map_data_two) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = margin_dir), color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#1A6B3C",
    mid = "grey20",
    high = "#6B2D8B",
    midpoint = 0,
    labels = scales::percent,
    name = "Margin"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "US Senate — Stratton vs. Krishnamoorthi",
    subtitle = subtitle_text
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "white", family = "roboto",
                              size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey70", family = "roboto", size = 10),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "white", family = "roboto"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "white", family = "roboto")
  )
```

```{r}
# get vote share out of all votes cast for all candidates
senate_all <- results |> 
  filter(race == "US Senate") |> 
  group_by(precinct_num) |> 
  mutate(total_votes = sum(votes)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(candidate %in% c("Juliana Stratton", "Raja Krishnamoorthi")) |> 
  mutate(vote_share_all = votes / total_votes)

# winner per precinct
senate_winner_two <- senate_all |> 
  group_by(precinct_num) |> 
  slice_max(votes, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(margin_dir = ifelse(candidate == "Juliana Stratton", 
                             vote_share_all, -vote_share_all)) |> 
  ungroup()

# join to shapefile
map_data_two <- northfield_precincts |> 
  left_join(senate_winner_two, by = "precinct_num")
```

```{r}
font_add_google("EB Garamond", "garamond")
showtext_auto()

cong_four <- results |> 
  filter(race == "9th Congressional District",
         candidate %in% c("Laura Fine", "Daniel Biss", 
                          "Phil Andrew", "Kat Abughazaleh"))

cong_winner <- results |> 
  filter(race == "9th Congressional District") |> 
  group_by(precinct_num) |> 
  slice_max(votes, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  select(precinct_num, winner = candidate)

map_cong <- northfield_precincts |> 
  inner_join(cong_four, by = "precinct_num") |> 
  left_join(cong_winner, by = "precinct_num") |> 
  mutate(won_precinct = candidate == winner)

map_cong_won <- map_cong |> filter(won_precinct == TRUE)

subtitle_text_cong <- "Laura Fine: 42.8%  |  Daniel Biss: 26.7%  |  Kat Abughazaleh: 11.7%  |  Phil Andrew: 11.5%  |  Others: 7.3%"

ggplot(map_cong) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = vote_share), color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = map_cong_won, aes(fill = vote_share), 
          color = "gold", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_sf_text(aes(label = precinct_num), color = "black",
               family = "garamond", size = 2.5) +
 scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "grey90",
    high = "#08306B",
    labels = scales::percent,
    name = "Vote Share"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ candidate, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "9th Congressional District Democratic Primary",
    subtitle = subtitle_text_cong,
    caption = "Orange outline = precinct winner  |  Source: Cook County Clerk  |  Graphic by Drew Duffy"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
   plot.title = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond",
                          size = 16, face = "bold",
                          margin = margin(l = -30)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond",
                                 size = 10, lineheight = 0.2, margin = margin(l = -30)),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond",
                                size = 8, hjust =  0),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond",
                              size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond", size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 15)
  )
```

```{r}
# data prep
assessor_two <- results |> 
  filter(race == "Cook County Assessor",
         candidate %in% c("Fritz Kaegi", "Pat Hynes"))

assessor_winner <- assessor_two |> 
  group_by(precinct_num) |>
  mutate(margin = vote_share - min(vote_share)) |> 
  slice_max(votes, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(margin_dir = ifelse(candidate == "Fritz Kaegi", margin, -margin)) |> 
  ungroup()

map_assessor <- northfield_precincts |> 
  left_join(assessor_winner, by = "precinct_num")

subtitle_text_assessor <- "Fritz Kaegi: 56.0%  |  Pat Hynes: 44.0%"

ggplot(map_assessor) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = margin_dir), color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf_text(aes(label = precinct_num), color = "black",
               family = "garamond", size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#00C957",
    mid = "grey85",
    high = "#9B30FF",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Head-to-Head Margin",
    breaks = c(max(map_assessor$margin_dir, na.rm = TRUE),
               0.15,
               0,
               -0.15,
               min(map_assessor$margin_dir, na.rm = TRUE)),
    labels = c("Kaegi", "+15%", "Even", "-15%", "Hynes"),
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      barheight = unit(6, "cm"),
      barwidth = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      ticks = FALSE
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Cook County Assessor Democratic Primary — Northfield Township",
    subtitle = subtitle_text_assessor,
    caption = "Source: Cook County Clerk  |  Graphic by Drew Duffy"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond",
                              size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond",
                                 size = 10, hjust = 0),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond",
                                size = 8, hjust = 0),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond", size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 15)
  )

ggsave("assessor_map.png", width = 8.5, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(tigris)
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

roads <- roads("IL", "Cook", progress_bar = FALSE)
places <- places("IL", progress_bar = FALSE)
```

```{r}
roads <- st_transform(roads, st_crs(northfield_precincts))
places <- st_transform(places, st_crs(northfield_precincts))
```

```{r}
nf_boundary <- st_union(northfield_precincts)
roads_nf <- st_intersection(roads, nf_boundary)
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = roads_nf, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = northfield_precincts, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
  geom_sf(data = roads_nf, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = vote_share), color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf_text(aes(label = precinct_num), color = "black",
               family = "garamond", size = 2) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "grey90", high = "midnightblue",
    labels = scales::percent,
    name = "Vote Share"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ candidate, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Metropolitan Water Reclamation District",
    subtitle = subtitle_text_mwrd,
    caption = "* = endorsed  |  Voters select up to 3  |  Source: Cook County Clerk  |  Graphic by Drew Duffy"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond",
                              size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond",
                                 size = 8, hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.3),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond",
                                size = 8, hjust = 0),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond",
                              size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond", size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 15)
  )

ggsave("mwrd_map.png", width = 8.5, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
results |> 
  filter(race %in% c("Circuit Court Judge (Cobbs)", "Circuit Court Judge (Coghlan)")) |> 
  group_by(race, candidate) |> 
  summarise(total = sum(votes)) |> 
  mutate(pct = scales::percent(total / sum(total), accuracy = 0.1)) |> 
  arrange(race, desc(total))
```

```{r}
font_add_google("EB Garamond", "garamond")
showtext_auto()

# data prep - Cobbs
cobbs_two <- results |> 
  filter(race == "Circuit Court Judge (Cobbs)")

cobbs_winner <- cobbs_two |> 
  group_by(precinct_num) |>
  mutate(margin = vote_share - min(vote_share)) |> 
  slice_max(votes, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(margin_dir = ifelse(candidate == "Luz Maria Toledo", margin, -margin)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(race_label = "Cobbs Vacancy\nLuz Maria Toledo vs. Linda Sackey")

# data prep - Coghlan
coghlan_two <- results |> 
  filter(race == "Circuit Court Judge (Coghlan)")

coghlan_winner <- coghlan_two |> 
  group_by(precinct_num) |>
  mutate(margin = vote_share - min(vote_share)) |> 
  slice_max(votes, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(margin_dir = ifelse(candidate == "Michael Cabonargi", margin, -margin)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(race_label = "Coghlan Vacancy\nMichael Cabonargi vs. Ashonta C. Rice")

# combine
circuit_combined <- bind_rows(cobbs_winner, coghlan_winner)

map_circuit <- northfield_precincts |> 
  left_join(circuit_combined, by = "precinct_num")

subtitle_text_circuit <- "Cobbs: *Toledo 65.5% | Sackey 34.5%\nCoghlan: *Cabonargi 63.7% | Rice 36.3%"

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = roads_nf, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_sf(data = map_circuit, aes(fill = margin_dir),
          color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_sf_text(data = map_circuit, aes(label = precinct_num), color = "black",
               family = "garamond", size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#00C957",
    mid = "grey85",
    high = "#9B30FF",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Head-to-Head Margin",
    breaks = c(0.40, 0.15, 0, -0.15, -0.40),
    labels = c("Toledo/Cabonargi", "+15%", "Even", "-15%", "Sackey/Rice"),
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      barheight = unit(6, "cm"),
      barwidth = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      ticks = FALSE
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ race_label, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Circuit Court Judge — Cook County",
    subtitle = subtitle_text_circuit,
    caption = "* = endorsed  |  Source: Cook County Clerk  |  Graphic by Drew Duffy"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond",
                              size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0,
                              margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond",
                                 size = 10, hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.4,
                                 margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond",
                                size = 10, hjust = 0,
                                margin = margin(t = 5)),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond",
                              size = 10, face = "plain",
                              margin = margin(t = 5, b = 5)),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black", family = "garamond", size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 15)
  )

ggsave("circuit_court_map.png", width = 8.5, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```
